title: Vaping Cases Referred to Health Sciences Authority and Those Referred by Parents
what_it_is: Vaping Cases Referred to Health Sciences Authority and Those Referred by Parents

sections.label: Parent referral for child vaping
sections.summary: One parent referral for child vaping over two years led to a warning and HPB counselling, not a fine.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In these two years, only one of these cases was a parent referring his child to the Police for vaping.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For this case, the person was issued with a warning instead of a composition fine and referred to the Health Promotion Board (HPB) for counselling.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Parents who are concerned that their children are vaping can call the HPB QuitLine for a referral to HPB’s smoking and vaping cessation service.

sections.label: Police referral and fine
sections.summary: The Police referred the case to HSA and the child was fined $300 for vaping.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: The Police referred the case to HSA and the child was issued with a $300 fine for vaping.

sections.label: Nuanced approach to voluntary cessation
sections.summary: Voluntary cases where parents bring the child forward are flagged to HSA for counselling and a warning.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: In general, we do take a very nuanced approach with regard to a voluntary situation where they want to stop vaping and the parents bring the child forward.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Typically, for this kind of situations, it will be flagged to HSA and we will then issue vaping counselling to the child, issue a warning instead.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: What I would advise parents, if they are faced with a situation where they suspect their children of vaping, please use the HPB hotline to get them some help, and appropriate support will be given to the children.

sections.label: HPB hotline for vaping cessation
sections.summary: Callers can use the HPB hotline and specify vaping cessation to receive the same support.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Like the smoking hotline, you can call HPB for their hotline and you can specify that it is an issue of vaping cessation, and the same support will be given to the individual who wishes to cease vaping.
